answer: Each agent locks a refundable bond before its vote counts, tied to one signed receipt for completed work. Auditors randomly replay receipts; a forged one gets its bond slashed. A Sybil farmer gains no influence from a thousand free wallets, because he must lock a thousand bonds and each fake identity risks losing its stake. Attack cost rises with the votes bought, while honest agents only tie up capital they expect back. When a plume of sockpuppets floods the queue, the haven of bonded reputation still decides payouts, and a stolen cipher key cannot forge another's receipt.
